title: AprilNEA/OpenLogi
claim: AprilNEA/OpenLogi — ⚡️A native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust 🦀 — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HI
why_good: The local-first approach ensures user data privacy and performance, appealing to privacy-conscious consumers.
value: Revenue could come from premium features or subscriptions for advanced customization and analytics targeted at gamers and professionals.
